name: Fusión de Límite Facial
description: Analiza la mezcla de contornos faciales para detectar deepfakes
algorithm: Face Boundary Blend — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes face-to-background boundary blending for deepfake detection following techniques from Face X-ray (Li et al., 2020):

1. **Límite Región Extracción**: The transition zone between the face and surrounding context (hair, neck, ears, background) is extracted. This region — typically 10-30 pixels wide — is where deepfake blending artifacts are concentrated.

2. **Alpha Matte Estimación**: The effective alpha transparency at the face boundary is estimated. Natural faces don't have alpha boundaries — they transition organically to hair and neck. Deepfakes produce a detectable soft alpha matte where the generated face was composited, creating an unnatural transparency gradient.

3. **Cross - Límite Feature Análisis**: Features on both sides of the boundary are compared: noise level, compression artifacts, color temperature, texture granularity, and local contrast. In authentic video, these features are continuous across the face boundary. In deepfakes, the separately generated face shows different characteristics than the original surrounding footage.

4. **Límite Shape Análisis**: The shape of the blending region is analyzed. Deepfake systems typically use simple geometric templates (ellipses, convex hulls of landmarks) for face masks. These produce unnaturally regular boundary shapes compared to the organic boundaries of natural face-to-hair and face-to-neck transitions.

5. **Per - Canal Límite Análisis**: The blending boundary is analyzed independently in each color channel and in frequency domain. Even well-blended deepfakes may show boundary artifacts in specific channels — particularly in chroma channels where blending algorithms may be less sophisticated than in luminance.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante face boundary blend analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
